profile.headline: Experienced Software Engineer Specializing in Full-Stack Development across multiple platforms

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Leveraged Generative AI to efficiently modernize and rewrite multiple backend and full-stack services, including Vue.js and ASP.NET applications.
• Applied GenAI-driven development practices to accelerate service modernization while maintaining code quality, functionality, and maintainability.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
• Developed and maintained security compliance software (MDM) deployed across 1M+ company-issued laptops, ensuring device security and compliance at enterprise scale.
• Delivered customer-facing features for the Amazon AMP iOS app, including playlist management and show-link sharing.
• Integrated key Amazon AMP functionality into the Amazon Music iOS app, expanding feature availability across Amazon’s music ecosystem.
• Built distributed services on AWS to enable grocery shopping experiences through Amazon Fresh, addressing requirements for scalability, availability, and operational efficiency.
• Developed a high-performance microservice that computed and served relevant grocery products within Amazon.com search results, meeting stringent sub-70ms latency requirements.
• Designed and deployed a serverless recurring-cart workflow, automatically adding customer-selected grocery items to carts based on configurable cadence and quantity.
• Delivered full-stack, high-visibility software to Amazon.com, optimizing systems for latency, availability, scalability, and efficiency at significant customer scale.
• Mentored junior engineers through hands-on technical guidance, pair programming, code reviews, and collaborative problem-solving.
positions.insights: Skills: Swift (Programming Language) · .NET Core · C# · Java · Kotlin · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: Software Developer Intern
positions.description:
• Developed an end-to-end, Facebook-style notification system using Java and Spring, backed by Amazon DynamoDB.
• Designed a flexible notification service supporting scalable queries and core notification management functions.
• Implemented event-driven notification generation and aggregation based on user interactions.
• Built a web-based UI for viewing, managing, and marking notifications as read.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Amazon Dynamodb

positions.title: Jr. Developer Intern
positions.description:
•	Implemented behavior tree for enemy AI character in C++ with the help of Unreal Engine
•	Architected and implemented the weapon switching/swapping system in C++ which is a core gameplay feature that will be used in the final game.
•       Implemented a weapon that shoots projectiles in the style of a shotgun.
•	Implemented a per tire particle effects system for a vehicle.
•	Converted many Unreal Blueprint systems to C++ code.

positions.title: QA Developer
positions.description:
•	Developed detailed software documentation that was verified through testing and was pushed to clients and potential customers to improve the usability of the product
•	Tested product features and provided feedback to developers and sales support in order to better handle issues that may arise.
•	Developed product demos intended to allure new clients by effectively demonstrating product features

projects.title: Chained Distributed File Storage
projects.description:
Language: Go
Implemented a variant of two-phase commit that allows nodes to trade files directly with one another and report their storage to a central coordinator following a transaction.
Implemented durable storage for transaction logging that allowed nodes to recover in the event of failure.
Implemented commands that users can enter to send and retrieve files from other nodes.

projects.title: Servo Web Browser Engine
projects.description:
Language: Rust
Refactored code to take advantage of code reuse and improve readability
Contributed a patch to fix a package manager update issue.
Contributed patch to ensure tests aren’t run when thread is panicking
